reason: Token deprecation (spec 041-token-deprecation), cumulative since baseline 0.0.0 and superseding declaration ki-button-quaternary-disabled (its deltas, and those of every declaration it supersedes, remain as declared there). No published name is added, renamed or removed and no effective value changes: the onmars and material3 stylesheets are byte-identical to the previous candidate apart from one comment after each deprecated declaration. 85 published component tokens that no component stylesheet, token, source or public document reads gain deprecation metadata on their token facet (deprecatedSince 0.1.0 and a replacement), which the gate classifies as MINOR: (1) the 50 ki-button pressed cells --ki-button-{variant}-{neutral,danger,success}-active-{bg,border,fg} and --ki-button-{variant}-active-shadow, replaced by the same rest cell, because a pressed button shows its resting cell under the pressed overlay; (2) the 30 ki-button disabled cells --ki-button-{variant}-{danger,success}-disabled-{bg,border,fg}, replaced by --ki-button-{variant}-neutral-disabled-{bg,border,fg}, because disabled does not depend on the tone; (3) --ki-input-focus-border and --ki-textarea-focus-border, replaced by their -focus-ring-color; --ki-input-min-target by --ki-input-height; --ki-select-hover-bg by --ki-surface-hover-overlay-inverse; and --ki-select-listbox-elevation by --ki-select-listbox-shadow. {variant} is each of primary, secondary, tertiary, quaternary and ghost. Their removal is scheduled for 1.0.0: the gate allows it only once a later minor has shipped the deprecation, and the tokens build fails if the package reaches 1.0.0 still shipping them.
